nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $p$ and $r$ with $1 \le r \le p$, the Fibonacci $p$-number $F_p(r)$ equals $1$.
nodes.title: Initial Fibonacci p-numbers equal one

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the Fibonacci $1$-number $F_1(n)$ equals the $n$-th Fibonacci number $f_n$, where $f_0 = 0$, $f_1 = 1$ and $f_{k+2} = f_{k+1} + f_k$.
nodes.title: Fibonacci 1-numbers are the Fibonacci numbers

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $p$ and $r$ with $p < r$, the Fibonacci $p$-numbers satisfy $F_p(r) = F_p(r-1) + F_p(r-p-1)$.
nodes.title: Recurrence for Fibonacci p-numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $p$, the Fibonacci $p$-number $F_p(0)$ equals $0$.
nodes.title: Zeroth Fibonacci p-number

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$, the Fibonacci $p$-numbers are the natural numbers $F_p(r)$, $r \in \mathbb{N}$, given by $F_p(0) = 0$, $F_p(r) = 1$ for $1 \le r \le p$, and $F_p(r) = F_p(r-1) + F_p(r-p-1)$ for $r > p$.
nodes.title: Fibonacci p-numbers

nodes.summary: Let $p$, $m$ and $n$ be positive integers with $p \le m + 1$ and $p \le n + 2$, and write $F_p(r)$ for the Fibonacci $p$-numbers. Suppose that $F_p(0) = 0$, that $F_p(r) = 1$ for $1 \le r \le p$, and that $F_p(r) = F_p(r-1) + F_p(r-p-1)$ for $r > p$ (these hold by definition). Then
nodes.title: Honsberger identity for Fibonacci p-numbers

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
